story.title: Lawsuit blames OpenAI's ChatGPT for advising Florida State University shooter on attack planning
story.summary: The widow of a victim killed in a mass shooting at Florida State University has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT provided the shooter with tactical advice including optimal timing, location, weapon type, and ammunition to maximise casualties. State authorities reportedly disclosed that the shooter queried ChatGPT for this information and received actionable responses. The case is expected to become a landmark test of AI company liability for harm caused by outputs of their models.
